provenance.source: Glass Chip C++ joint impedance controller for Franka Panda (control.cpp)
provenance.notes: Instruction counts: compiled with Homebrew clang version 22.1.7, --target=riscv64-linux-gnu -O2 -S -ffreestanding -fno-math-errno -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti -std=c++20, -march=rv64gc; instr = gem5-measured dynamic count 2303/call (calib/tables/cpu_gem5.json, T7_control_step; includes a few harness instructions), split by the static mix; static count of the compiled code was 2280 (both branch sides counted). (RT core has no vector unit). Static count of the compiled step function; flops_est counts FP arithmetic instructions with FMA as 2. Period/deadline are spec defaults.
references: Franka Emika Panda modified DH parameters (Franka docs)
Gaz, Cognetti, Oliva, Robuffo Giordano, De Luca, Dynamic Identification of the Franka Emika Panda Robot, RA-L 2019

ops.notes: read 7 joint positions and velocities plus status words from memory-mapped encoder registers (estimate)

joint impedance + RNEA gravity/Coriolis (control.cpp), 2303 RV64 instr per tick; instr = gem5-measured dynamic count 2303/call (calib/tables/cpu_gem5.json, T7_control_step; includes a few harness instructions), split by the static mix; static count of the compiled code was 2280 (both branch sides counted); 558 static instructions in the function body
write 7 torque commands to the motor drive registers (estimate)
